text: The robot delivered 116 out of 345 orders successfully within an average time of 44 seconds per order. The top failure reason was "unknown" issues, affecting [cite:7] and many other orders. Orders with warnings were mostly related to slow delivery times, often exceeding 2000 seconds for a single item. To improve reliability, focus on troubleshooting [[reachability]] issues, which are the most frequent cause of delays.
